name: Piyestra PRWA 03 Plastic Rattan Finish Chair
description: Elegant high-back plastic armchair with woven rattan-style design, armrests and 3-year warranty. Durable, lightweight and ideal for veranda, outdoor or indoor seating.
details: The Piyestra PRWA 03 is a stylish high-back plastic armchair featuring a realistic woven rattan texture. It offers comfortable armrests, a contoured seat and supportive backrest. Made from high-quality UV-protected plastic, it is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Lightweight yet strong, with a stackable design for easy storage. Perfect for homes, verandas, gardens and events in Sri Lanka. Backed by a 3-year manufacturer warranty.
